report_summary: Substantive evidence-led report follows actual participant uptake, reported bypass replication, failed as well as successful short persistence tests, explicit deletion-aware migration and accidental counter corruption. It accurately distinguishes event/page units and preserves authorization, affiliation and score uncertainty. The broad independence argument is framed more strongly than some local evidence but remains qualified by the missing rules and alternative provenance.
